description: DCAR-1 residues at the mapped HCAR3 ligand site, HCAR3 contacts for comparison, and the pocket volume figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
three2one={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(path):
    rows=[]
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: ri=int(line[22:26])
            except: continue
            rows.append((line[:6].strip(),line[12:16].strip(),line[17:20].strip(),line[21],ri,
                         float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["rec","atom","res","ch","resi","x","y","z"])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=(Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T).T
    return R,qc-pc@R
DC={'2.45':79,'2.48':82,'2.50':84,'2.52':85,'2.53':86,'2.55':88,'2.56':89,'3.32':116,'3.38':122,'3.41':125,'3.47':131,'3.54':138,'4.40':151,'4.50':161,'4.55':166,'5.32':197,'5.34':199,'5.48':214,'5.49':215,'5.51':217,'5.52':218,'5.53':219,'5.54':220,'5.57':221,'5.62':224,'5.63':225,'6.39':256,'6.45':262,'6.50':268,'6.53':271,'6.57':275,'7.30':289,'7.36':295,'7.39':298,'7.47':307,'7.48':308,'7.49':310,'7.50':311,'7.55':316}
r=requests.get("https://gpcrdb.org/services/residues/extended/hcar3_human/",timeout=90).json()
H={};Hrev={}
for x in r:
    gn=x.get("display_generic_number")
    if gn: g=gn.split("x")[0];H[g]=x["sequence_number"];Hrev[x["sequence_number"]]=g
dc=parse("AF-G5EDI0-v6.pdb");ho=parse("9JKT.pdb")
dca=dc[dc.atom=="CA"].set_index("resi");hca=ho[(ho.rec=="ATOM")&(ho.ch=="A")&(ho.atom=="CA")].drop_duplicates("resi").set_index("resi")
pairs=[(DC[k],H[k]) for k in DC if k in H and DC[k] in dca.index and H[k] in hca.index]
P=np.array([dca.loc[a,["x","y","z"]].values for a,b in pairs],float);Q=np.array([hca.loc[b,["x","y","z"]].values for a,b in pairs],float)
R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
for _ in range(5):
    d=np.linalg.norm(P@R+t-Q,axis=1);k=d<3.0;R,t=kabsch(P[k],Q[k])
lig=ho[(ho.rec=="HETATM")&(ho.res=="HF2")][["x","y","z"]].values
lig_dc=(lig-t)@R.T                     # ligand mapped into the DCAR-1 frame
# DCAR-1 BW lookup (interpolate within helices from the anchor set)
anch=sorted([(float(g.split(".")[0]),float(g.split(".")[1]),i) for g,i in DC.items()])
def bw_of(resi):
    for g,i in DC.items():
        if i==resi: return g
    for tm in range(1,8):
        A=[(p,i) for h,p,i in anch if h==tm]
        for (p1,i1),(p2,i2) in zip(A,A[1:]):
            if i1<resi<i2 and (i2-i1)==(round(p2*100)-round(p1*100)):
                return f"{tm}.{int(round(p1*100))+resi-i1}"
    return ""
pa=dc[dc.rec=="ATOM"]
d,_=cKDTree(lig_dc).query(pa[["x","y","z"]].values)
near=pa.assign(dlig=d).query("dlig<5.0")
tab=(near.groupby(["resi","res"]).dlig.min().reset_index().sort_values("dlig"))
tab["aa"]=tab.res.map(three2one);tab["BW"]=tab.resi.map(bw_of)
tab=tab[["resi","aa","BW","dlig"]].rename(columns={"dlig":"min_dist_to_mapped_ligand_A"})
tab["min_dist_to_mapped_ligand_A"]=tab.min_dist_to_mapped_ligand_A.round(2)
tab.to_csv("dcar1_residues_at_mapped_HCAR3_site.csv",index=False)
print("DCAR-1 residues within 5 A of the HCAR3 D-phenyllactate position after BW superposition:")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
basic=tab[tab.aa.isin(list("RKH"))]
print("\nbasic residues at that site:", "none" if basic.empty else basic.to_string(index=False))
# HCAR3 side for comparison
dh,_=cKDTree(lig).query(ho[(ho.rec=="ATOM")&(ho.ch=="A")][["x","y","z"]].values)
hn=ho[(ho.rec=="ATOM")&(ho.ch=="A")].assign(dl=dh).query("dl<5.0")
ht=hn.groupby(["resi","res"]).dl.min().reset_index().sort_values("dl")
ht["aa"]=ht.res.map(three2one);ht["BW"]=ht.resi.map(Hrev)
print("\nHCAR3 contacts (same cutoff):")
print(ht[["resi","aa","BW","dl"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
V=pd.read_csv("pocket_volume_comparison.csv");C=pd.read_csv("apo_alphafold_pocket_control.csv")
hol=V[V.receptor!="DCAR-1"]
ax[0].barh(hol.receptor,hol.pocket_volume_A3,color=["#1f77b4" if c=="acid" else "#d62728" for c in hol["class"]])
ax[0].axvline(138,ls="--",c="k");ax[0].text(145,0.2,"DCAR-1 model\n138 A3",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("buried cavity volume at the ligand site (A3)")
ax[0].set_title("Ligand-bound structures: blue small acid ligands, red peptide ligands")
lab=list(C.receptor)+["DCAR-1 (model)"];val=list(C.apo_AF_pocket_A3)+[138]
col=["#1f77b4" if c=="acid" else "#d62728" for c in C["class"]]+["#2ca02c"]
ax[1].barh(lab,val,color=col)
ax[1].set_xlabel("buried cavity volume in the apo AlphaFold model (A3)")
ax[1].set_title("Apo AlphaFold models, seed transferred from the holo ligand")
for a in ax: a.invert_yaxis(); a.grid(axis="x",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
